title: eval.run.completed
description: The eval service ran one suite of the eval harness under a profile and stored the run with its gates and their drift against the previous run of the same suite and profile. Eval runs are platform data, so tenant_id is null. Producer: eval. Consumers: none yet.

run_id.description: The stored run; GET /v1/eval/runs/{run_id} has every gate.

profile.description: The harness profile: ci gates the scripted and fake providers, nightly a real model through the gateway.

passed.description: True when every gate passed; false when one failed or none was measured.

gates_total.description: How many gates the run measured.

failed_gates.description: Names of the gates that failed, as suite.metric[provider] (>=baseline added for a gate held to another suite's value).

regressed_gates.description: Names of the gates whose value fell since the previous run of the suite and profile, whether or not they still pass; empty for the first run.

previous_run_id.description: The previous run of the same suite and profile the drift is measured against; null for the first run.
